name: early_corporate
archetype: Early 2000s corporate enterprise software company website
market: United States, B2B enterprise technology, Fortune 500 buyers
density: Moderate density with rigid table-based layouts. The page feels boxy and structured — clear regions but no organic flow. Above-the-fold real estate dominated by a Flash-like hero banner (replicated in HTML/CSS using a gradient blue rectangle with centered text). Left navigation column (180px fixed) with collapsible tree menus using CSS only. Main content column (60% width). Right column (20% width) with press releases and customer logos. CONSTRAINT: No CSS border-radius. No CSS gradients. No flexbox or grid — use HTML tables and float-based layout only. No rounded corners anywhere. This must look genuinely frozen in 2003.
nav_style: Fixed top bar with horizontal text navigation links separated by pipes: Home | Products | Solutions | Partners | Support | About | Contact. Below it a breadcrumb. The left column has a persistent vertical tree navigation that expands on click using CSS. No mega-menus — just hierarchical indentation.
commercial_model: Enterprise software. Lead generation website. Everything points to 'Contact Sales' or 'Request a Demo'. Case studies, white papers, and webinars gated behind email forms. No pricing publicly listed.
color_palette: Corporate blue (#003087) and steel grey (#4A4A4A) dominant. White page backgrounds. Accent orange (#FF6600) for CTA buttons. Light blue (#DDEEFF) for alternating table rows and info boxes. The overall effect is conservative, trustworthy, dated.
typography: Verdana and Arial — the corporate web-safe standards of the era. Headings in dark blue at 16-18px. Body text at 12-13px. All-caps labels for section headings. Link text always underlined. No Google Fonts, no web fonts.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Three-column layout. Left nav tree. Center hero with product tagline and 3 feature bullets. Right sidebar with latest press release and customer logo strip. Bottom footer with all site links.

pages.title: Products
pages.description: Product catalog in a table with product name, description blurb, and 'Learn More' link. Product comparison table. Featured product highlight box at top.

pages.title: Solutions by Industry
pages.description: Industry vertical landing pages: Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Government, Retail. Each with a customer quote and case study link.

pages.title: Partners
pages.description: Partner ecosystem page with partner tier badges (Gold, Silver, Authorized). Partner directory search. Partner program benefits table. 'Become a Partner' CTA.

pages.title: About Us
pages.description: Company timeline since founding in 1997. Executive team photos in a table grid. Press releases list. Awards and certifications badges. Mission statement.
